audit_items.proof_trace: Go map iteration order is non-deterministic per language spec. The code iterates over sidecarByIndex map appending columnIndex values, producing unsorted cellsIndices array. C-KZG library precondition (sorted indices) is violated, causing reconstruction failure or undefined behavior.
audit_items.attack_scenario: Attacker sends valid data columns via P2P gossip. Victim node stores columns in map and triggers reconstruction. Map iteration produces randomized unsorted indices passed to C-KZG library, violating precondition and causing DoS or data corruption.
